name: QELCare-Website-Multispecialty-Clinic-Management-System
description: Full-stack, multi-role clinic management system for multispecialty clinics. React + Node/Express + PostgreSQL. Handles appointments, patient queue, medical records, lab-result OCR (Gemini), medications, billing, and AI analytics (Ollama), with JWT/RBAC auth, email OTP, and hardened security. Deployed on Vercel + Railway.

paragraphs: A full-stack clinic platform that runs the whole patient journey — from booking and check-in to per-specialty queues, consultations, and cashier billing — with AI-assisted document processing, push/email/SMS notifications, and role-based access for six clinic roles.

QELCare is a management system for a multispecialty outpatient clinic. It models the clinic's real operational flow as an enforced state machine: a patient books an appointment, the Frontdesk confirms it, a nurse takes vitals and routes the patient into the correct specialty queue, a doctor runs the consultation and records findings, and a cashier settles billing. On top of that it adds AI document intelligence, role-based dashboards, multi-channel notifications, and an audit trail over sensitive actions.
The system has three parts that share one backend:
features: End-to-end appointment lifecycle — PENDING → CONFIRMED → INQUEUE → FORBILLING → COMPLETED, with CANCELLED, RESCHEDULED, and NOSHOW as side exits.

Slot protection — PENDING and RESCHEDULED requests do not hold a doctor's slot; the slot is claimed on confirmation, backed by a unique partial index (uqdoctordatetime). If two requests collide, the loser is…

Atomic check-in and settlement — confirming or checking in a same-day appointment creates its queue entry in the same transaction, so a failure never leaves an appointment INQUEUE without a queue row.

Automated clinic lifecycle job — every 5 minutes the API settles past, unresolved appointments to NOSHOW (120-minute grace), resolves stale queue entries (past days, skipped over 30 minutes, or still waiting after the 8…
Per-specialty patient queues across 8 departments — Cardiology, Gastroenterology, General Medicine, Ob-Gyne, Pediatrics, Psychiatry, Rehabilitation Medicine, and ENT.

requirements.text: Layered abuse defense — per-account login lockout and per-email OTP cooldown at the database layer, plus IP-based rate limits on login, OTP, password, patient registration, patient search, inquiries, AI insights, and the public display.
Create your own admin account and never ship default credentials.
